content.title: Product Proof Variant | Baseline, Dose, Use, Motion Result, Return
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult original user, one label-free product and a visible pre-use state in the same light. Show a measured dose leaving the same product and arriving on a visible hand or tool. Apply the retained dose through one continuous readable action to one declared area. Prove the result through touch, movement and consistent lighting rather than a disconnected beauty cut. Return the same adult, product and treated state in one stable closing frame.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one clearly adult original user, one label-free product and a visible pre-use state in the same light. + Show a measured dose leaving the same product and arriving on a visible hand or tool. + Apply the retained dose through one continuous readable action to one declared area. + Prove the result through touch, movement and consistent lighting rather than a disconnected beauty cut. + Return the same adult, product and treated state in one stable closing frame.
quick_start.recommended_input: In original window light, establish one clearly adult leather craftsperson with a dry cracked brown work boot and one label-free frosted conditioner bottle visible together; keep face, boot and light direction stable. Without a cutaway reset, she rubs the retained dose across only the boot's left toe and side panel in three continuous strokes. Return to the same adult holding the same bottle beside the boot, with treated and untreated areas readable in one frame. Hold with no logo, claims or extra text.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original user, one label-free product and a visible pre-use state in the same light. Show a measured dose leaving the same product and arriving on a visible hand or tool. Apply the retained dose through one continuous readable action to one declared area. Prove the result through touch, movement and consistent lighting rather than a disconnected beauty cut. Return the same adult, product and treated state in one stable closing frame. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original user, one label-free product and a visible pre-use state in the same light.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Apply the retained dose through one continuous readable action to one declared area.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Prove the result through touch, movement and consistent lighting rather than a disconnected beauty cut.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Return the same adult, product and treated state in one stable closing frame.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.
